description: This file defines a Retrofit API service interface `StreamlyApiService` for the Streamly backend, specifying endpoints for fetching user-specific continue watching items and available TV channels.

classes.name: StreamlyApiService
classes.description: Retrofit interface defining endpoints for fetching content data related to continue watching items and TV channels.

methods.name: getContinueWatching
methods.description: Fetches Continue Watching items for a specific user identified by userId.

methods.name: getTvChannels
methods.description: Fetches a list of available TV channels with current program information.
